_comment: USD price per 1,000,000 tokens. Rates verified against Anthropic's published pricing as of `_ratesAsOf`; prices change over time — edit freely and update that date. Cache rates are derived from `input` via cacheMultipliers (Anthropic standard: read 0.1x, 5-min write 1.25x, 1-hour write 2x); a model row may override any of them with its own `cacheMultipliers`. `fast` prices responses with usage.speed 'fast' (fast mode; without it such responses count as unpriced). `longContext` prices responses whose prompt (input + cache write + cache read) exceeds `above` tokens. Model ids match exactly, or after dropping a date suffix (-20251001); Bedrock and Vertex spellings (us.anthropic.…-v1:0, …@20250805) map to the same rows. `webSearchPer1000` prices web search requests (web fetch is free). Costs in the receipt are labelled 'estimated equivalent API cost'; on a Pro/Max subscription you don't pay per token.
